name: Yodobashi Akiba
desc: Nine-floor electronics mall next to the station. Games, toys, tax-free, food court. The family stop if you only do one Akiba building. Price: free to enter; budget the kid a cap before the toy floors.

name: Gachapon Kaikan
desc: Hundreds of capsule machines in one hall. Cash, 20–40 minutes is plenty. Set a yen limit at the door. Closed some New Year days; check X before you walk. Price: about ¥200–¥500 a play.

name: Akihabara UDX lights
desc: Winter lights on the UDX plaza, typical mid-December to late January. Free after Yodobashi or Kanda Myojin. Confirm dates on the building site; shops inside may be under works. Price: free.

name: Ganso Sample-ya
desc: Fake-food shop plus a wax workshop (tempura and lettuce). Kids from year 1; Japanese briefing. Pair with Asakusa. Price: shop free; workshop typically a few thousand yen per piece.

name: Small Worlds Tokyo
desc: Indoor miniature city. Good rain day near teamLab Planets. Last entry one hour before close. Price: about ¥3,200 adult / ¥1,700 child 4–11; under 4 free.

name: Meguro Parasitological Museum
desc: Free two-floor parasite museum. Closed Mon and Tue so skip 5 and 11 Jan. 30–40 minutes. Not for the squeamish. Price: free; donation welcome.

name: Sewerage Museum Rainbow
desc: Walk-through pipes and pumps. Free, near Small Worlds. Closed Mondays so skip 11 Jan. Weekend pump demos. Price: free.

name: 2k540 Aki-Oka Artisan
desc: Craft shops under the tracks between Akihabara and Okachimachi. Closed Wednesday 6 Jan. Quiet after the gacha halls. Price: free to walk; shops extra.

name: Godzilla head Shinjuku
desc: 12 m Godzilla head on the 8th-floor terrace. Street photo is free; closer look from the hotel lounge. Five minutes, then leave Kabukicho. Price: free from the street.

name: Sky Circus Tenbou Park
desc: 251 m deck with nets and a park theme. Cheaper and weirder than Skytree. Book weekends. Price: weekday about ¥700 adult / ¥500 child; weekend more.

name: Himiko water bus
desc: Leiji Matsumoto ships Himiko, Hotaluna, Emeraldas. Book the Asakusa–Odaiba run. Himiko has maintenance weeks; sister ships cover. Price: about ¥2,000 adult / ¥1,000 child one way.
